name: BCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Xero is the only champion this holding attests, retaining the belt against Ace on 25 April 2008; no earlier or later history survives.

name: BCW International Championship
epitaph: Killer K is the only champion this holding attests, retaining the belt against Fusion on 14 July 2008 in their fourth billed meeting ("Fusion vs. Killer K IV") — implying at least three earlier, unrecorded defenses against the same challenger; no earlier or later history survives.

name: BCW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Danger Dave is the only champion this holding attests, retaining the belt against Xander on 14 July 2008; no earlier or later history survives.

name: BCW World Championship
epitaph: Commander D is the only champion this holding attests, retaining the belt against Alex Austin in a team lumberjack match on 25 April 2008; no earlier or later history survives.

name: BCW Triple Crown Championship
epitaph: Total Destruction defeated the defending champion, Eric Hinz, on 14 July 2008 — the only title change this holding attests, and the only one of BCW's five 2008-era titles to actually change hands in the surviving record. No earlier history survives.
